title: Mid-level frontend engineer
provenance: Provisional assistant-authored synthetic role; extends frontend-discovery-v1 without practitioner calibration.
context: Build and maintain a React/TypeScript operations dashboard: filters, asynchronous API data, debugging, checks before release and accessible controls. Judge evidence in the supplied interview, not overall ability.

statuses.specific_evidence: A concrete relevant personal action with a mechanism, observation or check is described. Self-report is not independently verified; explicit limits can coexist with this status.
statuses.limited_evidence: Some relevant activity is described, but ownership, mechanism or verification is too vague or indirect to establish a specific account.
statuses.not_established: No relevant completed action is established: topic absent, answer missing, only future plans, or explicit nonperformance. This is not evidence of inability.
statuses.conflicting_evidence: Candidate turns make incompatible statements about the same material contribution or event. Preserve both and ask for clarification; do not infer intent.

criteria.label: Implementation and data flow
criteria.lookFor: Specific interface behavior, action-to-data flow, implementation choices and personal contribution.
criteria.specificAnchor: Names a personal implementation action and explains how an input/request/state change reaches the interface.
criteria.limitedAnchor: Mentions a team feature or tooling without a clear personal action or data mechanism.
criteria.boundary: Shared components, an existing API, and team ownership do not establish sole authorship.

criteria.label: Debugging and diagnosis
criteria.lookFor: Symptom, investigation steps, observations supporting an explanation and a check of that explanation.
criteria.specificAnchor: Describes a reproduction or investigation and concrete observations connected to a causal hypothesis.
criteria.limitedAnchor: Reports trying the screen or proposing a cause without observations to distinguish it.
criteria.boundary: A reported fix or closed ticket does not verify production success.

criteria.label: Verification and testing
criteria.lookFor: Specific checks, intended assertions or expected behavior, and limits of checks actually performed.
criteria.specificAnchor: Describes a concrete test or manual check and its expected behavior.
criteria.limitedAnchor: Says tests passed or a file downloaded without establishing a relevant assertion or coverage.
criteria.boundary: Missing one test type does not imply no testing ability; a team green suite does not prove coverage.

criteria.label: Accessible interfaces
criteria.lookFor: Concrete accessible interface behavior or accessibility checks personally performed.
criteria.specificAnchor: Describes a specific label, keyboard, focus or assistive-technology check and relevant behavior.
criteria.limitedAnchor: Reports an accessibility-related implementation detail without checking or explaining relevant behavior.
criteria.boundary: Library use and future intentions alone do not establish completed accessibility work or conformance.

questions.text: Describe a frontend feature you worked on. How did data move from a user action to the interface, and what did you implement?
questions.clarification: What happened when the inputs changed again before the previous request finished?

questions.text: Walk me through a user-facing defect you investigated. What did you observe, and how did you decide what was causing it?
How did you check the change and decide it was ready for release?
questions.clarification: What did those checks leave untested or uncertain?

questions.text: What accessibility work or checks did you perform on this interface?
Looking back, what were the limits of your ownership or evidence, and what would you investigate or ask for help with next?
